name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Senior Customer Success Manager | B2B SaaS
summary: Customer success and account management professional with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, owning post-sale relationships from onboarding through adoption, renewal, and expansion. Retained ~94% of a 15-20 partner reseller network at Birdeye, including channel sales to healthcare-focused agencies, by analyzing utilization data to catch adoption gaps early. Led onboarding for 25+ clients a month at Wix at 110% of implementation targets while leading a team of up to 20. Runs data-backed business reviews, success planning, and hands-on training, with Salesforce, HubSpot, and integration experience across SaaS platforms.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the strategic relationship for a portfolio of B2B service clients, running discovery to surface goals and building plans with measurable outcomes.
Lead onboarding for new technology stacks, translating business requirements into configurations and delivering hands-on training.
Identify expansion opportunities and scope complementary services aligned with each client's objectives through proposals and SOWs.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights, using dashboards that track funnel progression and ROI.
Integrate client systems through APIs, Zapier, Make, and n8n, and document every interaction and deliverable in the CRM.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder accounts, delivering QBRs that translated performance data into strategic recommendations.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, including channel sales to healthcare-focused agencies, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify underused capabilities and adoption gaps, recommending interventions that reduced churn.
Led onboarding and training for a high-volume partner network, driving adoption of marketing-automation and reputation-management tools.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, equipping them to communicate product value.
Shared structured, prioritized customer feedback with Product and Engineering, and managed the book in Salesforce.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end, covering execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, including a banking-industry client.

bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 110% of implementation targets and 120% of sales targets.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), overseeing scope and delivery timelines.
Led onboarding and launch as primary strategic contact, delivering on time and shortening time-to-value.

experience.title: Account Executive

Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled.
